# AML Detection and Legal Risk Review

This confidential bank document outlines key compliance and risk management tasks:

*   Review AML detection processes quarterly.
*   Monitor legal risks specifically for Strategy 2026.
*   Optimize legal risks based on recent audit findings.
*   Update internal controls to align with Strategy 2026.
*   Review updates to AML detection standards.
